rules.rewired: degree-preserving directed double-edge swaps; exact in/out degree sequences; no self-loops; no duplicates; 20*E swap attempts; synapse counts randomly permuted
rules.random: directed Erdos-Renyi, identical N and E, no self-loops; synapse counts randomly permuted from the biological multiset
rules.entry_output: entry/output index subsets reused (same counts) for all graphs; random graphs assign the same LPLC2 entry set by convention (declared limitation for rewired/random: entry/output subsets are not biologically meaningful there)
rules.syn_init: all controls (rewired + random) initialize from the biological synapse-count multiset, randomly permuted across edges; verified identical (sorted) to g1_bio.npz syn_init values
rules.fanin_norm_note: model init divides syn_init by sqrt(post in-degree); final init distributions are near-identical for rewired (degree-sequence matched) and can differ for random (degree sequence differs) — see init_fanin_stats; rewired is the primary topology control; --no-fanin-norm provides the raw-init ablation arm
